item.title: Tassel 1.29
item.description: Everything you set up now syncs to your other Macs: your own to-dos, class colors, names and order, hidden classes, grade category changes, zeros, dismissals and more. New: use Tassel in Claude on the web. Turn it on in Settings > AI > Claude on the Web and add the URL as a custom connector in claude.ai (Tassel needs to be open on your Mac).

item.title: Tassel 1.28
item.description: Turning in a Google Doc link shows what's in it, before and after, instead of Canvas's picture of a sign-in page, and warns you if your teacher can't open it. When Canvas has graded something StudentVUE still shows as missing, Tassel uses the Canvas grade until StudentVUE catches up.

item.title: Tassel 1.27
item.description: Copy an assignment's Tassel tag from its details; Take the Zero moved out of the way. Circle and friend invites notify sooner and again if re-sent, you're told when a friend request is accepted, and People in the sidebar shows waiting invites. The Circles list no longer overlaps. Wagers are simpler: challenge someone head to head or pick who'll score highest, with set stakes.

item.title: Tassel 1.26
item.description: Mail: each Canvas account in Tassel's Mail account now has a Grades mailbox, with an email for every grade showing the percent, what it's worth, your class grade now, the teacher's comment, links to Tassel and Canvas, and the Tassel tag. Messages link back to Tassel and Canvas too. The sidebar lines counts and grades up on either side of one line again, and the board hides No Class unless you have your own to-dos.

item.title: Tassel 1.25
item.description: School-wide announcements are filtered to you: ones for another grade or for a club or team you're not in stay off To Do (they're still in Activity). Tell Tassel your grade and clubs in Settings > General > About You. AI agents and the ChatGPT rewrite now follow built-in writing rules that keep work from sounding AI-written, along with your own writing voice.

item.title: Tassel 1.24
item.description: Pictures in assignments, pages and announcements are read and summarized, with logos and other junk left out. AI agents can save Docs, links, emails, people and notes with an assignment (shown as Saved in its details), read which assignment a Tassel tag belongs to, and put pictures into school-account Google Docs too. Editing school-account Google Docs works again after a Google change. The board is cleaner: classes with nothing to do are hidden, cards show their class color, time and a quick check button. Tassel now keeps your classes from earlier years, linked to this year's in the same subject.

item.title: Tassel 1.23
item.description: AI agents connected to Tassel now pick up new tools after an update without restarting, and get clearer instructions: how to read and do assignments, add Tassel tags everywhere, and get work turned in (you always click Submit). Writing voice: choose a folder describing how you write in Settings > AI, and Super Intelligence and agents write like you. Agents can put files into Turn In, and check whether your Canvas group, friends or circle members have turned something in. School-wide Canvas announcements show in Activity and as a banner on To Do, flyers included. The sidebar shows letter grades again.

item.title: Tassel 1.22
item.description: ChatGPT rewrite is easier for AI agents to find and use: it's now called chatgpt_rewrite, agents are told to run writing you'll turn in through it, and apps that show MCP prompts offer it as a ChatGPT rewrite command.

item.title: Tassel 1.21
item.description: Pictures in Google Docs: AI agents can put pictures into a new Doc, into an existing Doc after a paragraph or in a table cell, from a web link, Google Drive or a file on your Mac. A link turned in as a file now carries the assignment's Tassel tag, on the page and out of sight. Agents are told to add the tag to anything they make for an assignment, whatever app they use. Connecting ChatGPT is more reliable, with a way to sign in through Terminal if it doesn't go through.

item.title: Tassel 1.20
item.description: Turning in a link where an assignment only takes files: the link is always uploaded as a small web page file that opens it, whatever it links to (1.19 turned Google files into PDFs instead).

item.title: Tassel 1.19
item.description: Hidden text: Tassel checks assignments, Google Docs and files for text you can't see (white, tiny or invisible, sometimes planted to catch AI use), leaves it out, and shows what it found in the assignment's details. AI agents get the same warning and are told never to follow it. Agents can fill in an assignment's Turn In panel with a link or text for you to check and submit; when an assignment only takes files, a Google Doc, Slides or Sheet link is turned in as a PDF (or the Word, PowerPoint or Excel file it takes). Agents can also sync your accounts, and rewrite a passage with ChatGPT so it reads naturally. Tassel syncs every 10 minutes.

item.title: Tassel 1.18
item.description: Time per assignment: counted while it's open in Tassel (optionally in your browser) or with a timer, with what you turned in, kept on your Mac. Tassel tags: a one-line code on work Tassel makes or turns in, naming the assignment and your school email (both students' on shared work); never a Canvas comment, so teachers aren't notified. The board shows classes side by side, each with its stages; drag a to-do to another class to move it, and Done folds away. Circle wagers with pretend tokens, 100 a week, never money. The Tassel Improvement Program: opt in to send more about your work and get Pro while you're in it; leaving deletes what you sent. Privacy policy updated.

item.title: Tassel 1.17
item.description: Sync Between Macs keeps another Mac identical: logins (now including school and Google sign-ins) always arrive, the newest copy wins, and your settings and edits (class nicknames, colors, order, what you marked done or important, notes) come along. Friend requests and circle invites always send a notification. Classmates' school emails are added to contacts saved under just a first name. Circles show stats, a weekly recap, deadlines you share, and superlatives.

item.title: Tassel 1.16
item.description: Daily agendas: a short summary of the day and links to the assignments it's about, on the class page and in the details panel. Agendas made in Google Slides are read again. The details panel is wider and slides open smoothly, and the search field is wider. Switching pages in the sidebar is faster, especially People. What to do fits in one box and no longer shows another assignment's steps.

item.title: Tassel 1.15
item.description: To Do: Today, Upcoming and Done along the top, so past and later work is a click away. Smoother tab switching with Liquid Glass. Sidebar counts and grades line up. A cleaner Settings layout. Faster startup, and StudentVUE finds your school by itself during setup. Uses less power, especially in Low Power Mode. List icons line up with their titles.

item.title: Tassel 1.14
item.description: Assignments show What to do: the steps and requirements pulled from the instructions and the documents they link. A class's Work tab opens with its daily agenda, kept up to date. Syllabi are formatted, with an At a glance box. File summaries are clearer. Messages show the assignment they're about, with your grade or whether it's turned in, and a button to open it. Messages about work you've already turned in are resolved for you. When an announcement or message moves a due date, the assignment updates and notes which message moved it; you can switch back to Canvas's date.

item.title: Tassel 1.13.1
item.description: Class and school rankings now include your friends and circle members, not just people who share with everyone, and each is labeled. The leaderboard's menu shows circles cleanly with their icons and full names, and your own row is marked with a simple You tag. Every row in the sidebar uses the same font weight.

item.title: Tassel 1.13
item.description: Circles: make a group with a name and an icon, invite people (even ones not on Tassel yet), and rank together on the leaderboard, overall or by class. Owners can open a circle to everyone in one of their classes, their grade or their school; those show up under Circles You Can Join. Joining a circle lets its members see your rank and grades, unless your grade sharing is set to No one.

item.title: Tassel 1.12
item.description: Faster: accounts sync at the same time and start-up finishes in a fraction of the time. Daily agendas load in the background in seconds, and a failed read keeps the last one. Smoother class tabs. The selected sidebar row is always blue with a white icon and name. Announcements from the whole school year now show up (some were being missed). Modules and Applications no longer cut text off; Applications finds sharper icons and summarizes library resources. Comparing grades with friends waits out busy moments instead of failing. The ZIP code in setup is found automatically. No more password prompts from old Keychain items or the Mail bridge, which now only listens on your Mac.

item.title: Tassel 1.11
item.description: Tassel now runs on macOS 15. Everything works there except Apple Intelligence (summaries and the on-device assistant), which needs macOS 26. Settings → AI shows how to update. On macOS 15 the assistant can still use Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini or your own API key.

item.title: Tassel 1.10.2
item.description: The calendar is laid out like Apple's Calendar: every day on one hour scale, the same columns every week (Monday to Friday plus the weekend), and due work, absences and all-day events in a strip on top. Click any assignment to see it in the side panel. The selected item in the sidebar now shows its icon clearly.

item.title: Tassel 1.10.1
item.description: Pro is now checked with Tassel's server. If Pro turned off after the last update, this brings it back. Before an AI assistant or connected AI app shares, moves, replaces or trashes a Google Drive file, Tassel asks you first. People no longer merges two different students who share a name, and each address shows once.

item.title: Tassel 1.10
item.description: Friends: add classmates as friends (even before they use Tassel), invite them by email, and see who uses Tassel next to their name. Leaderboard: under People, overall or by class. Click anyone for their grades, rank and trend, and compare classes with friends. The top 3 in each school get an award when a quarter ends. Class numbers: anonymous class averages and likely scores once 3 classmates use Tassel. Grade sharing is in Settings → Accounts, friends by default, with Delete My Data. Contacts: People uses your contacts for names and photos, and adds school addresses to them once. Messages about work you've since turned in leave Needs Your Attention, and message windows link the work they mention.

item.title: Tassel 1.9.3
item.description: People: everyone from your classes, groups and school directory in one place. Search by name or part of an address, with teachers and staff kept apart from students. Join, invite to and announce in groups. Click anyone to see their addresses and the classes you share. More Classes: open courses that aren't in your sidebar from the ⋯ by the Classes heading or Go → More Classes…. Tassel reads them only once you open them. Documents linked from an assignment now show with it. A saved password is set aside only when the site actually rejects it.

item.title: Tassel 1.9.2
item.description: Marking periods work properly: last quarter's finished work leaves To Do, and each quarter's grades show only that quarter's work. Daily agendas also come from class documents, with a sentence on each linked document. Messages show the assignments and documents they're about. To Do has a filter. Tassel syncs again when you get back online.

item.title: Tassel 1.9.1
item.description: StudentVUE opens signed in. Sign-ins are saved only once they work, so a mistyped password is never kept, and sign-in windows no longer pop up on their own.

item.title: Tassel 1.9
item.description: New quarter handled properly: last quarter's grades and work are kept, the Grades tab can switch between marking periods, and the sidebar shows last quarter's grade until the new one has grades. Take the Zero closes an assignment for good. Lunch shows in Today and Calendar (pick yours once), and free periods like study hall and independent study show as Free Period.

item.title: Tassel 1.8.5
item.description: Attendance: see your unexcused absences and tardies by class (Calendar → Attendance, and on each class page), mark anything that might be wrong, and copy a note for the attendance office. StudentVUE's attendance notifications now show their notes. Applications now includes your library's resources and the tools your classes share.

item.title: Tassel 1.8.4
item.description: You can drag and drop files into Turn in. Nothing is submitted until you confirm.

item.title: Tassel 1.8.3
item.description: Daily agendas: when a class's Canvas home page links its agenda, today's shows on Today and at the top of the class's Work tab (click it for the whole thing). Applications also lists the outside tools your classes link, like dictionaries, tutoring and Zoom. App tiles have tidier names and logos are no longer cut off.

item.title: Tassel 1.8.2
item.description: Canvas messages stay the same everywhere: flagging, archiving, deleting or moving one to a folder in Mail matches in Tassel and Canvas, and the other way around. Right-click a class's link buttons to copy the link.

item.title: Tassel 1.8.1
item.description: Sidebar icons no longer fade out in Mission Control.

item.title: Tassel 1.8
item.description: See and send your Canvas messages from the Mail app: turn it on in Settings → Accounts → Mail, and each school gets its own account in Mail (StudentVUE messages can be read there too). Grades is now the last tab on class pages, and file names for uploads and downloads are tidier.

item.title: Tassel 1.7.4
item.description: Grades: letter grades StudentVUE still flags as missing now count, dual-enrollment classes show the college's Canvas grade next to StudentVUE's, and outside-tool assignments and undated work are labeled.

item.title: Tassel 1.7.3
item.description: Grades tab: easier to read rows (stripes, dates and status in columns, the selected assignment highlighted), Canvas work in its category, and extra credit that only adds to your grade. Clicking around is much faster.

item.title: Tassel 1.7.2
item.description: See what you turned in right in the details panel (your text, link or Google Doc, and files). Grades show a calculated letter grade on your school's scale. StudentVUE letter and percent grades no longer go missing next to Canvas work, renamed assignments link up, and past on-paper work shows on class pages. Assistants are told never to turn anything in without your approval.

item.title: Tassel 1.7.1
item.description: Grades: shorter notes, with the details in a tooltip. Apps is now called Applications, with sharper icons, your school's short name, and filtering from the regular search bar.

item.title: Tassel 1.7
item.description: Google Drive, Docs, Sheets and Slides for Super Intelligence and connected assistants: search, read, create and edit files in your Google accounts (edits keep pictures, tables and formatting), and copy files between accounts. New Apps page with the apps from your school's sign-on portal. Sign-in windows skip past passkey prompts and remember sign-ins per account. Sync between Macs no longer needs a passphrase. Late work that's still accepted shows as still open. Screenshots in other picture formats are uploaded as PNG. Fixes and speedups.

item.title: Tassel 1.6.4
item.description: Click “worth X% of your grade” on any assignment to see how it's figured, move it to another category, or jump to it on the Grades tab. Upcoming work's previews now add up sensibly, and Canvas assignments linked to StudentVUE aren't counted twice. Your school Google account can sign in by itself with your school login, a progress bar shows while summaries run, and flagged assignments aren't listed twice on class pages.

item.title: Tassel 1.6.3
item.description: Grades: upcoming tests and quizzes from Canvas show in their category with what they'll be worth, without counting until they're graded (or you try a what-if). Add an upcoming assignment that isn't in Canvas yet: its category and points are filled in for you. Classes whose StudentVUE only shows totals (like dual enrollment) now use Canvas's assignments as the gradebook. StudentVUE grades link to their Canvas assignments more often, even when they're named differently.

item.title: Tassel 1.6.2
item.description: Google Docs keep their formatting: syllabus tables and headings show the way the teacher made them. Your school Google accounts now sign back in by themselves through your school's sign-in (pictures included), and signing in to Canvas connects your school Google account right away. Super Intelligence (and other AI apps connected to Tassel) can now open what's in your modules: pages, files and discussions. Updates now install automatically by default.

item.title: Tassel 1.6.1
item.description: Fixes: signing back in to your school in the background no longer pops up the sign-in window when it actually worked. On the Grades tab, a click shows an assignment in the details panel and a double-click opens it, and more StudentVUE grades are linked to their Canvas assignments. Action buttons in the details panel have room and wrap instead of squeezing.

item.title: Tassel 1.6
item.description: A new setup that does the work for you: sign in to your school's Canvas once, and Tassel connects your school's Google account and StudentVUE with that same sign-in wherever it can. Add a second Canvas (like a college) or skip it. If StudentVUE wasn't found, a ZIP code finds your district (your school's is picked for you) with your username and password already filled in; any Google account that didn't connect is one click. Everything can be skipped and changed later in Settings.

item.title: Tassel 1.5
item.description: Stay signed in without thinking about it: sign in once in Tassel and it remembers your school sign-in (username, password, and the pictures for picture-password logins like RapidIdentity), then signs you back in by itself in the background whenever your school signs you out. The same sign-in keeps your school Google accounts connected (and adds them for your schools on its own) and fills in StudentVUE when you add it. Saved only on your Mac; it stops at any login error so it never locks your account.

item.title: Tassel 1.4
item.description: Grades, reimagined: every assignment shows your score as a percent and how much of your class grade it's worth, everywhere (lists, details, the Grades tab), with bars for what you kept and lost. Ungraded work shows what it will be worth without counting yet; work that's closed or a week late without being turned in counts as an estimated 0. Change an assignment's category or add your own, saved per class. The official grade sits next to Tassel's calculation. Super Intelligence: knows your Do First ranking, grades, schedule and attached files, answers in tidy sections, and shows what it's doing. Use Apple Intelligence (Local), Claude (Subscription), ChatGPT or Gemini with your own account (set up right in Tassel, no API key), or any API key, each with its choice of model. Connect Tassel to other AI apps (Claude, Codex, Cursor, VS Code and more). Also: signed-in Canvas accounts stay signed in with an access token; scanned PDFs are read; documents get summaries; resolve messages and announcements without deleting them; StudentVUE zeros for work you've since turned in on Canvas no longer count.

item.title: Tassel 1.3
item.description: Today now puts what to do first at the top, ranked by how soon it's due, how much it's worth and how long it takes, with the few messages that really need you. One To Do list with All, Today, Upcoming, Missing, Important and Done. AI summaries of messages, announcements and assignments, with time and effort estimates. One search that works on the page you're on. Grades shown out of 100 with what each assignment is worth. Join Canvas classes you're invited to, keep your accounts in sync between Macs, course links on each class's home page, videos that open in Tassel, a cleaner sidebar and bigger text. Also fixes sign-ins that could be lost overnight.

item.title: Tassel 1.2
item.description: Tassel is now free for everyone, with Tassel Pro for invited students. New: assignment types you can filter and sort, one layout for assignments and messages, optional on-device summaries with an Action Needed list, and a week-long Pro trial.

item.title: Tassel 1.1
item.description: Sign-in fixes for schools with their own login pages, Important items, a better menu bar panel, Settings → Classes, automatic updates.
